decisions.reason: As a newly launched line with its own page and clear fit with the firm's integrated drainage portfolio, management is likely to continue supporting it rather than reverse course after only one year.
A floor-level shower drainage system sits close to the firm's stated direction toward low-profile and accessible bathroom solutions, so recent investment and strategic fit favor retention.
Because the firm presented this designer shower drainage line as a flagship for its future direction, public commitment and the need to justify that stance make withdrawal very unlikely.
This shower element with integrated slope supports installation ease and renovation use cases central to the firm's positioning, so management would likely keep backing it.
